analysis.reasonEn: Following the previous buy decision, RSI slightly rose from 42.9 to 43.2, and MACD histogram improvement continued. However, entering the SMA20 (114,810 KRW) resistance zone and a 0.47 ratio of trading volume compared to the 5-day average indicate weakening buying pressure. While the 20-day ADX remains strong at 30.0, the -DI (33.2) is above the +DI (20.2), showing downward pressure dominance. The 52-week position at 34.3% remains low. Until the current price of 103,675 KRW breaks through the SMA20 resistance at 114,810 KRW and trading volume increases, a wait-and-see approach is maintained.
